'''Sandhills Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/?p=58075|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Transco interconnect, Iredell County, North Carolina to Richmond County power plant, near Hamlet, North Carolina.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/?p=58075|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''North Carolina Natural Gas<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/?p=58075|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''300 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''84 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/?p=58075|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/?p=58075|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/?p=58075|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
